query: Please implement an API management website to handle client HTTP requests. The website should have functionalities for accepting and processing HTTP requests, returning responses, and more. Users should be able to send HTTP requests through the website, view request results, manage API interfaces, and monitor request logs. Design the site using ivory as the background and chocolate for content blocks.
